title: नेपाली भाषा कक्षामा सिकाइ सहजीकरणसम्बन्धी अभिमत {Learning Nepali language in class Opinions on facilitation}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानमूलक लेख नेपाली भाषाको सिकाइ सहजीकरणका क्षेत्रमा केन्द्रित छ ।माध्यमिक तहको नेपाली भाषा कक्षामा सिकाइ सहजीकरणको परम्परा र प्रवृत्तिका सम्बन्धमा शिक्षकहरूको अभिमत के कस्तो छ भन्ने प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासाको खोजी गर्नु यस अनुसन्धानको उद्देश्य हो । यसका लागि अनुसन्धानमा गुणात्मक ढाँचा, व्याख्यावादी दर्शन, घटना अनुभवपद्धति र निर्माणवादी सिद्धान्तको आधार लिइएको छ । सोद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट विधिमाआधारित भएर लामो समय नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण गरेका सातजना भाषा शिक्षकसँग पुगी गहनअन्तर्वार्ता उपकरणका माध्यमबाट तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । सङ्कलित तथ्याङ्कबाट विभिन्न थिम वा आशय निर्माण गरी प्राज्ञिक जिज्ञासा र दाबीका आधारमा साक्ष्य र तर्कलाई लम्बीय र क्षितिजीय रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरेर निष्कर्षमा पुगिएको छ । अनुसन्धानबाट वि.सं. २०२८पूर्वको भन्दा पछिको नेपाली भाषा सिकाइ सहजीकरण प्रक्रिया क्रमशः वैज्ञानिक, प्रयोजनपरक र सिपकेन्द्रित हँदै आएको पाइएको छ । वि.सं. २०२८ पूर्व कहीँ, कतैमात्र प्रयोग गरिने शिक्षण सामग्रीको उपयोग, शिक्षण विधि र मूल्याङ्कन, सिकारुमैत्री शिक्षण, सहयोगात्मकसिकाइ, उत्प्रेरणा, पृष्ठपोषणजस्ता सिकाइ सहजीकरणका आधारभूत पक्षमा वि.सं. २०२८पछि विशेष ध्यान पुगेको पाइन्छ । वि.सं. २०७१ को माध्यमिक नेपाली पाठ्यक्रमसँगै नेपालीभाषा कक्षामा सिकाइ सहजीकरण प्रक्रियालाई थप प्रायोगिक, व्यवस्थित, अन्तक्र्रियात्मकर भाषा शिक्षणको मर्म अनुकूल बनाउन खोजिएको देखिन्छ । वि.सं. २०२८ अघि र पछिमूलतः शिक्षक केन्द्रित शिक्षण विधिमा आधारित नेपाली शिक्षण क्रमशः विद्यार्थीमैत्री सिकाइ सहजीकरणको उपयोगतर्प नेपाली भाषा शिक्षण केन्द्रित हुँदै आएको पाइन्छ । नेपाली भाषा सिकाइ सहजीकरणको परम्परा र प्रवृत्तिका विषयमा सम्बन्धित शिक्षकहरूको अभिमतबारे रुचिराख्नेहरूका लागि प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धान उपयोगी हुने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: This research article focuses on the field of learning facilitation in the Nepali language. The objective of this research is to explore the academic inquiry into what kind of opinions teachers hold regarding the traditions and trends of learning facilitation in secondary-level Nepali language classrooms. For this purpose, the research adopts a qualitative framework, interpretivist philosophy, a phenomenological method, and constructivist theory as its foundation. Based on a purposive sampling method, data were collected by approaching seven language teachers who had taught the Nepali language for a long time, utilizing an in-depth interview tool. From the collected data, various themes or meanings were constructed, and conclusions were reached by presenting evidence and arguments longitudinally and horizontally based on academic inquiries and claims. The research reveals that the Nepali language learning facilitation process after B.S. 2028 has progressively become more scientific, pragmatic, and skill-centered compared to the period prior to B.S. 2028. It is found that after B.S. 2028, special attention has been paid to fundamental aspects of learning facilitation—such as the utilization of instructional materials that were only rarely used prior to B.S. 2028, teaching methods and evaluation, learner-friendly instruction, collaborative learning, motivation, and feedback. With the secondary Nepali curriculum of B.S. 2071, an effort appears to have been made to make the learning facilitation process in Nepali language classrooms more practical, systematic, interactive, and aligned with the spirit of language teaching. Nepali language teaching, which was primarily based on teacher-centered instructional methods before and after B.S. 2028, is found to have gradually become focused toward the utilization of student-friendly learning facilitation. The present research appears to be useful for those interested in the opinions of concerned teachers regarding the traditions and trends of Nepali language learning facilitation.

informal_english: This research paper is focused right on the field of learning facilitation in the Nepali language. The main aim of this research is to look into what kind of opinions teachers have regarding the traditions and trends of learning facilitation in secondary-level Nepali language classes. For this, the study takes a qualitative framework, interpretivist philosophy, phenomenological approach, and constructivist theory as its basis. Based on a purposive sampling method, data was collected by sitting down with seven language teachers who had taught the Nepali language for ages, using in-depth interviews. From the collected data, various themes and meanings were drawn up, and conclusions were reached by laying out evidence and arguments both longitudinally and horizontally based on academic queries and claims. The research shows that after B.S. 2028, the Nepali language learning facilitation process gradually became more scientific, purpose-driven, and skill-centred compared to before B.S. 2028. You find that after B.S. 2028, proper attention was paid to fundamental aspects of learning facilitation—like using teaching materials that were only ever used once in a blue moon before B.S. 2028, teaching methods and evaluation, learner-friendly teaching, collaborative learning, motivation, and feedback. With the B.S. 2071 secondary Nepali curriculum, you can see an effort was made to make the learning facilitation process in Nepali language classrooms more practical, systematic, interactive, and in tune with the spirit of language teaching. Nepali language teaching, which was mostly based on teacher-centred methods before and after B.S. 2028, is found to have gradually shifted towards the use of student-friendly learning facilitation. This research looks to be dead useful for anyone interested in what teachers think about the traditions and trends of Nepali language learning facilitation.
